name: 200726_1238_FR_IceCave.wav
description:
La grotte de Glace, Ice Cave. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect) 
I Made this recording in a glacier called La Mer De Glace, located near Chamonix (France),  where you can visit an ice cave. Here is my walk there. (you can hear steps in the metal footbridge, the water streams from the glacier, voices from the tourist in the cave...)
Recorded in July 2020 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Soundman OKM I binaural microphones (version 2018). 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
